name: pam_shells
detailed_description: Account module that restricts login access to users whose shell is listed in /etc/shells. Prevents login by users with restricted or administrative shells. Commonly used to prevent system accounts from logging in.
notes:
Validates that user's login shell is in /etc/shells. Prevents non-standard shells from being used for login.
